title: Bottlenecked: The Capital Cost of Protected DeFi Lending
abstract: arXiv:2611.26948v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Securing hundreds of billions of dollars in decentralized finance (DeFi) requires both cryptographically secured collateral and economic capital to absorb losses that collateral alone cannot cover. Composability makes both the amount and location of this protection matter: Kelp's nearly \$300 million April 2026 bridge exploit showed how an attacker could borrow against stolen assets across lending markets. We study how to allocate junior capital that absorbs losses before users incur losses in lending protocols. The main object we study is a tripartite graph that records user assets, their covered liabilities, and the junior capital permitted to pay them. Cuts in this graph determine what protection is missing, while a static security game on the graph defines how much such protection should cost. We call this cost the adversarial default premium (ADP), which can be viewed as the excess cost of insurance in composable financial systems

translated_title: 《瓶颈化：受保护DeFi借贷的资本成本》
translated_abstract: 保障去中心化金融数千亿美元资产的安全，既需要密码学保护的抵押品，也需要经济资本来吸收抵押品本身无法覆盖的损失。可组合性使得这种保护的数量和位置都至关重要：2026年4月Kelp近3亿美元的跨链桥攻击事件表明，攻击者可以利用被盗资产在各借贷市场中进行抵押借贷。我们研究如何在借贷协议中分配劣后资本，使其在用户遭受损失之前先行吸收损失。我们研究的主要对象是一个三方图，它记录了用户资产、其受保护的负债，以及被允许用于偿付这些负债的劣后资本。该图中的割决定了保护措施的缺失之处，而图上的静态安全博弈则定义了这种保护应当付出的成本。我们将这一成本称为对抗性违约溢价，它可以被视为可组合金融系统中保险的超额成本。
tldr: 该论文提出用一个记录用户资产、受保护负债和劣后资本的三方图框架来识别DeFi借贷中的保护缺口，并通过静态安全博弈定义对抗性违约溢价，以量化可组合金融系统中保护性资本的配置成本。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a tripartite graph framework linking user assets, covered liabilities, and junior capital to identify protection gaps in composable DeFi lending, and defines the adversarial default premium (ADP) via a static security game to price that protection.
